newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti opening delayed for second time.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti opening delayed for second time.

text.p: The start of trading in shares of troubled Olivetti was delayed for a second time on the Milan stock market on Monday as price quotes were below a 15 percent trade limit, dealers said.
Olivetti, whose last official price was 749 lire before it was suspended on Thursday and Friday, was quoted at around 605/610 lire per share in pre-opening price fixing, traders said.
The stock market council later said trading in Olivetti stock was now expected to open at 1202 local time (1002 GMT) after pre-opening price fixing.

Bourse authorities widened the trading bands to 15 percent from the normal 10 percent earlier on Monday but traders noted the price quotations exceeded 15 percent and said unless bands were widened to 20 percent the stock was unlikely to open.
